verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.newrelic.com that serves clean markdown versions of the documentation. Several doc pages are also reachable as .md URLs (e.g., the CLI, SDK and vulnerability-agent pages), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and detail on how much of the documentation the llms.txt index covers.
